import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_85/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_85/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_85/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Step 1: Join Source5_85_4 and Source5_85_1 on 'Ord_id'
df_4_1 = pd.merge(source4, source1, on='Ord_id', how='inner')

# Step 2: Join the result with Source5_85_0 on 'Ship_id'
df_4_1_0 = pd.merge(df_4_1, source0, on='Ship_id', how='inner')

# Step 3: Group by nothing and aggregate sum of Sales
# This matches the operation history and produces the final Sales sum
total_sales = df_4_1_0['Sales'].sum()

# Create the target DataFrame with the same schema as target: ['Sales': float]
# The target examples show multiple rows, but the operation history shows only aggregation without group by,
# so we produce a single-row DataFrame with the total sales sum.
Target5_85 = pd.DataFrame({'Sales': [total_sales]})

# Save the result to the specified path
Target5_85.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_85_4 with Source5_85_1 on Ord_id
result = pd.merge(source4, source1, how='inner', left_on='Ord_id', right_on='Ord_id')

# Join the result with Source5_85_0 on Ship_id
result = pd.merge(result, source0, how='inner', left_on='Ship_id', right_on='Ship_id')

# Join the result with Source5_85_2 on Cust_id
result = pd.merge(result, source2, how='inner', left_on='Cust_id', right_on='Cust_id')

# Join the result with Source5_85_3 on Prod_id
result = pd.merge(result, source3, how='inner', left_on='Prod_id', right_on='Prod_id')

# Aggregate sum of Sales (no group by since target schema has only Sales column)
final = pd.DataFrame()
final['Sales'] = [result['Sales'].sum()]

# Write output to the specified path
final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_85/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
